record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: For a fixed integer m at least 2, characterize the bivariate copulas C:[0,1]^2 -> [0,1] that are m-ultramodular, meaning that for every k in {2,...,m} and all points (x,y),(u1,v1),...,(uk,vk) in [0,1]^2 for which every argument remains in [0,1]^2, the alternating finite-difference sum over all subsets J of {1,...,k} of (-1)^(k+|J|) C(x + sum_{i in J} ui, y + sum_{i in J} vi) is nonnegative. Also characterize the associative and Archimedean subfamilies of such copulas.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let m ≥ 2 be a fixed integer. A bivariate copula is a function C : [0,1]² → [0,1] such that C(x,0)=C(0,y)=0, C(x,1)=x, C(1,y)=y, and C is 2-increasing, i.e. for all 0 ≤ x₁ ≤ x₂ ≤ 1 and 0 ≤ y₁ ≤ y₂ ≤ 1,
   C(x₂,y₂) − C(x₂,y₁) − C(x₁,y₂) + C(x₁,y₁) ≥ 0.

For an integer k ≥ 1, points (x,y) ∈ [0,1]² and increments (u₁,v₁), …, (u_k,v_k) ∈ ℝ² such that for every subset J ⊆ {1,…,k} the point
   (x + Σ_{i∈J} u_i,  y + Σ_{i∈J} v_i)
lies in [0,1]², define the k-th alternating finite-difference of C at (x,y) with increments (u_i,v_i) by
   Δ_k C := Σ_{J ⊆ {1,…,k}} (−1)^{k+|J|} C(x + Σ_{i∈J} u_i,  y + Σ_{i∈J} v_i).

Call C m-ultramodular if Δ_k C ≥ 0 for every k ∈ {2,…,m} and every admissible choice of base point and increments as above.

A copula C is called associative if C(C(x,y),z) = C(x,C(y,z)) for all x,y,z ∈ [0,1]. An associative copula is Archimedean if it admits a representation
   C(x,y) = φ^{[-1]}(φ(x) + φ(y)),
where φ : [0,1] → [0,∞] is a continuous, strictly decreasing convex function with φ(1)=0, and φ^{[-1]} denotes the pseudo-inverse of φ.

Problem. 
(a) Characterize the bivariate copulas C that are m-ultramodular.
(b) Characterize those m-ultramodular bivariate copulas which are associative.
(c) Characterize those m-ultramodular bivariate copulas which are Archimedean, and in particular characterize the additive generators φ of such copulas.
artifact.status_search_result: The case m=2 (ultramodular copulas) has been characterized: an ultramodular bivariate copula is exactly a 2-increasing copula whose horizontal and vertical sections are convex; sufficient conditions on additive generators of Archimedean ultramodular copulas are known and ultramodular copula constructions have been developed. A complete characterization for general m ≥ 3, including the associative and Archimedean subfamilies, does not appear to have been fully established in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Ultramodularity and copulas
status_evidence.snippet: An ultramodular bivariate copula is characterized by the convexity of all of its horizontal and vertical sections.
status_evidence.claim: The m=2 case has a known characterization via convexity of sections.

status_evidence.title: Copula constructions using ultramodularity
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions are given for the additive generators of Archimedean ultramodular bivariate copulas.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for Archimedean ultramodular copulas via their additive generators.

status_evidence.title: The key role of convexity in some copula constructions
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions for bivariate copulas based on ultramodular aggregation functions and Schur concavity.
status_evidence.claim: Further constructions in the ultramodular setting have been developed but general m-ultramodularity is not fully characterized.
